function: No learned physical-layer function: the DNN only predicts outage probability and ergodic capacity (pp. 10-11); phase shifts, power and UAV position use closed-form or search methods (pp. 4, 8-9).
notes: Title on page 1 matches the DOI. Analytical outage and capacity study of a UAV-mounted active IRS NOMA network. The DNN (80,485 parameters, p. 12) is a supervised regression surrogate with 14 inputs and five outputs (outage probabilities and ergodic capacities), trained on Monte-Carlo data (pp. 10-11). Phase shifts are set coherently in closed form (p. 18); power allocation and UAV position come from Algorithms 1 and 2 (pp. 8-9). Code function would also apply, since performance prediction is none of the seven areas.
